value.message: EarlyON Child and Family Centres in Acton and Georgetown run free drop-in play for ages 0-6 with a parent - Links2Care says, though I could not get into a page with times today. Halton Region Public Health says Kids & Me at the Acton library is free Thursdays 1-2:30pm from the second week of Sept. I'll keep watching and text you when EarlyON times turn up.
